Overview

Three of Europe's favourite cities in one trip. Start with Paris and the Eiffel Tower, take the train to Amsterdam's canals and tulip country, then fly to Rome for the Colosseum and the Vatican. Hotels are 4-star and centrally located, and an expert guide joins you for the main sightseeing.

Tour highlights

  • Eiffel Tower (2nd level) and Seine river cruise
  • Disneyland Paris or Versailles (choose one)
  • Amsterdam canal cruise and Zaanse Schans windmills
  • Keukenhof tulip gardens (seasonal, March–May)
  • Colosseum, Roman Forum and Vatican Museums
  • Schengen visa assistance with appointment support
✈ Flights🏨 4★ Hotels🚄 Rail Pass🧳 Expert Guide

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Arrive in Paris

Fly from Mumbai to Paris. Transfer to your hotel. Evening free to stroll the Champs-Élysées.

Day 2 Paris city tour & Eiffel Tower

Guided tour of the Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Élysées, Place de la Concorde and Louvre (outside). Visit the Eiffel Tower 2nd level, then an evening Seine river cruise.

  • Breakfast
Day 3 Disneyland Paris or Versailles

Choose a full day at Disneyland Paris or a guided visit to the Palace of Versailles.

  • Breakfast
Day 4 Paris to Amsterdam by train

High-speed train to Amsterdam (about 3.5 hours). Afternoon canal cruise and free time at Dam Square.

  • Breakfast
Day 5 Zaanse Schans, Volendam & Keukenhof

Visit the windmills of Zaanse Schans and a cheese farm, then the fishing village of Volendam. In spring, visit Keukenhof gardens instead.

  • Breakfast
Day 6 Amsterdam to Rome

Fly to Rome. Check in and enjoy an evening walk to the Trevi Fountain and Spanish Steps.

  • Breakfast
Day 7 Ancient Rome

Guided tour of the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. Afternoon at the Pantheon and Piazza Navona.

  • Breakfast
Day 8 Vatican City

Guided visit to the Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel and St Peter's Basilica.

  • Breakfast
Day 9 Free day in Rome (optional Pisa / Florence)

Day at leisure, or take an optional day trip to Florence and the Leaning Tower of Pisa.

  • Breakfast
Day 10 Depart for Mumbai

Check out and transfer to Rome airport for your flight home.

  • Breakfast

Frequently asked questions

How early should we apply for the Schengen visa?

Apply 6–8 weeks before travel, and up to 3 months before in peak season. Our visa team prepares your file and helps you book the appointment.

Can we add Switzerland to this tour?

Yes. Many guests add 2–3 nights in Switzerland between Paris and Rome. See our Switzerland Honeymoon package or ask for a custom quote.
